subject: Customer adoption story & usage metrics for Q4 expansion
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer adoption story & usage metrics for Q4 expansion

Hi Sofia —

Congrats again on the successful rollout. As we discussed on the last call, the renewals team is building a short "success packet" to support BrightBridge's upcoming expansion conversation with procurement. The packet pairs a short customer story (1 page) with 3 clean metrics and a 1–2 sentence quote that we can use in a case brief and in a renewal/upsell playbook.

Could you help with the following by EOD Tuesday?
- Top-line metric you’re comfortable publishing (e.g., % reduction in inference latency or throughput gains)
- One operational metric (e.g., average weekly active models calling Redwood, or cache hit rate)
- One dollarized/efficiency metric if available (e.g., estimated monthly GPU cost savings vs prior stack)

I attached a quick template and an example quote to show format. If there are PHI or contract restrictions we should redact, please flag them — we can anonymize counts.

If you're okay, we can also include the short quote below in the packet: "Redwood made real-time inference feasible for our clinical scoring pipelines — lower latency, far fewer missed alerts." Please feel free to edit.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-case-brief-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB), template_metrics_request.txt (TXT, 3KB)

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer adoption story & usage metrics for Q4 expansion

Diego —

Thanks for the template, and happy to help. Attached is a CSV export with the weekly usage and a short suggested quote. High level (we are happy to make these public with light redaction):
- Latency: median per-request latency improved from ~220ms to ~95ms after moving prefix caching on (57% drop)
- Adoption: number of active inference pipelines rose from 9 to 28 over the last 6 months (3.1x)
- Cost: estimated GPU spend reduction ~28% month-over-month for the same throughput (internal calc)

Suggested quote: "Redwood's serving runtime let us scale clinical scoring without rebuilding our infra — faster responses at lower cost."

Two notes: 1) please redact patient counts in any public materials; 2) legal asked that any dollarized savings be marked as an estimate (we can sign off once final calculation is baked).

I've attached the usage export (brightbridge_usage_export_202707.csv). Let me know if you want a Slack call to walk through the numbers.

—Sofia
Sofia Martinez | Director, ML Ops — BrightBridge Health
Attachment: brightbridge_usage_export_202707.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Customer adoption story & usage metrics for Q4 expansion

Folks — forwarding Sofia's response and the CSV. Key ask: legal wants dollar savings flagged as estimate, and customer requests patient counts redacted. Monica — can you review the attached CSV and confirm the three metrics are safe to publish with those redactions? Marissa — can you slot the approved quote into a 1-page case brief (I attached the draft) and prep a DocuSign agreement for a quick quote approval? Aditya — FYI on potential data-point anonymization (we may need to trim absolute user numbers).

Thanks — aiming to have the final packet ready for the renewal call on Wed.

Diego

Diego — thanks for the flag and the CSV. Quick read: the three metrics look publishable once we do two things: 1) redact absolute patient counts and any direct identifiers; 2) append a footnote for the cost number stating "estimated internal calculation; customer to confirm".

Marissa — please take Diego's draft, replace the sample quote with Sofia's suggested quote, and add the redaction note. I also suggest we add a single-slide visual: weekly active pipelines (bar) + median latency delta (line) to make it easy for the renewals deck.

Aditya — can you confirm the wording for the anonymization clause? I'm fine to move forward with a signed approval from Sofia once the brief is updated.

Monica Patel | Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final case brief and quick approval request

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the fast turnaround. Attached is the updated 1-page brief and a DocuSign link for a short approval (we only need agreement to the three bullet metrics and the one-sentence quote, plus the redaction note). Link: https://docusign.com/r/redwood-brightbridge-approval-4582

If that's all good, sign and we'll include the brief in the renewal packet and share a replay with procurement. If you'd prefer a quick 15-minute sync to walk the numbers before signing, I'm happy to schedule.

Best,
Diego
